propositions: Extract two plain functions (build_model_settings and build_usage_limits) from runner.py into structured_run.py module, with build_model_settings taking cfg/req/caps/resolved/cache_settings and model_override parameter, and build_usage_limits returning tuple of (usage_limits, req_limit, eff_max_iter).

build_model_settings must remain pure with no side effects; the _TEMPERATURE_WITHDRAWN_LOGGED mutation must stay inline in run() to maintain structured_run.py as a leaf module without runtime imports from runner.

cache_settings must be passed as an explicit parameter to build_model_settings rather than recomputed, preserving the model_override guard that keeps cache settings None on the offline TestModel path.

eff_max_iter and req_limit must be returned as independent values from build_usage_limits because eff_max_iter cannot be recovered from the returned UsageLimits object (only max(8, eff_max_iter) is stored as tool_calls_limit).
Extraction must maintain structured_run.py between 100-500 LOC (373 current, 477 after extraction) and reduce runner.py below 700 LOC (699 before to 647 after), with durable comments preserved.

Seam guard in test_structured_run_seam.py must be updated to include build_model_settings and build_usage_limits in both hardcoded symbol lists, and any monkeypatch targets that moved must be repointed in the same commit.
